comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Aide Fleet recipes for the +1 Navigation clothes/accessories? You probably already knew, but just in case, they should all be listed here:

gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemGroupShow?id=22

Google Translate renders them as "Clothing sewing secretary - RegionName", e.g. Oceania, or Africa. They're credited as being available from the "Commerce Administration Bureau" NPC.

Helpfully, selecting a specific region shows all recipes from it, Sewing and Handicrafts alike. The only real trick besides translating it all, is figuring out what the outfits look like... but I'm sure it's not that hard to do. Cheers. And congrats on that fine work over at the Wikia, as well.
